style.vernacular: Small Melanesian harbour capital on Efate: low-rise (1-3 storey) painted concrete-block and render buildings with deep verandahs, French-quarter and British-paddock colonial legacy, corrugated-iron roofs in red, green and grey, waterfront timber and thatch (natangura leaf) nakamal and bungalow-style resort buildings, cyclone-hardened simple gable and hip roofs; lush tropical vegetation, coconut palms and banyan; one tall hotel-casino is the tallest building in the country.
style.ornament: Wall paintings on the post office and the building opposite the market hall; carved wooden totem poles and a stylised pig-tusk monument near Parliament; Melanesian carved posts and woven natangura thatch on nakamal and resort bungalows; French-quarter shuttered windows and verandahs.

sources.what: tropical rainforest climate, west-coast harbour, French quarter and British paddock, modern cathedral, wall paintings, tallest building is the hotel-casino, cyclone and earthquake damage. Wall and roof hex colours are typical observed palette choices, not measured.
